title: Rainbow Fish Home | KEY.co
meta_description: Secluded bliss in an amazing retreat
description_expanded: The entire house, both inside and out, has been thoughtfully painted with vibrant colors, creating a refreshing and inviting atmosphere. Gorgeous hardwood floors now grace every corner, lending an air of sophistication to the space. The kitchen has been completely redone, boasting a brand-new countertop, cabinets, and state-of-the-art appliances, including the coveted Margaritaville Frozen Concoction Maker. Everything you need for culinary bliss is at your fingertips. And for coffee enthusiasts, we have you covered with both a Keurig and a standard coffee maker. Ascending to the second floor, you'll discover three beautifully appointed bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The master bedroom welcomes you with a king-size bed, providing the perfect haven for rest. The second bedroom features a queen-size bed, while the third bedroom offers two full beds, accommodating larger groups or families. Connecting the master and second bedrooms is a breathtaking porch, where you can begin your day with a steaming cup of coffee or unwind with a good book, surrounded by tranquility.

Features: Microwave Air conditioning TVOutdoor Pool Garden
We do not guarantee internet connectivity.
